title: TrustBound: Payment-Epoch Completeness Reproducibility Artifact
description: Reviewer artifact accompanying TrustBound: A Mechanized Note on Payment-Epoch Completeness (TrustBound_Reviewer_Artifact_v1.1.0-review.6.zip, 45 entries with a per-file manifest). Contains the Lean admission and provider-contract models and checkers (14 exported results, eight rejected premise-removal mutations), a finite evidence-rule diagnostic with nine tests reproducing 2,048 records, the experimental SQLite payment gate with 170 selected tests, six service histories with 64 transitions checked against the Lean model (five closed, one undrained; two invalid inputs rejected), 864 generated operation schedules, 40 scripted-client cases and 84 concurrent-worker cases. It establishes conditional model results under a trusted-service contract, not completeness of a real processor deployment or a new general closure principle. Requires Python 3.11+ and Lean 4.19.0; no credentials, provider calls, SDK or Docker are needed. Code, Lean models and documentation are MIT-licensed; the manuscript is distributed separately under its own terms.
